# Kisaki Project

A modular WhatsApp bot built with JavaScript and powered by Baileys.

## About

Kisaki Project is a WhatsApp bot built around a modular plugin system. Commands and features are organized independently, making customization and maintenance straightforward.

### Features

- Plugin-based architecture
- Command handler
- WhatsApp Multi Device
- Built with JavaScript
- Powered by Baileys
- Easy to extend

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install
```

```bash
npm start
```
